We are currently seeking an experienced Operational Excellence & COPQ (Cost Of Poor Quality) Transformation Specialist to join our committed team.
Reporting directly to our Chief Transformation Officer and indirectly to our Chief Manufacturing Officer, you will be responsible for driving operational excellence across all VENTORA Group manufacturing sites. Your focus will be accelerating the reduction of COPQ, supporting Transformation projects and preparing sites for scalable growth. This role is key in ensuring the readiness of Red List sites and ensuring that manufacturing processes are optimized to support business growth targets, including a 2x increase in in capacity.

•	Operational Systems and Process Standardization: Work closely with local Operational Managers to develop and standardize operational systems, quality control, and inventory management processes across all sites.
•	Cross-functional Collaboration: Collaborate with various departments to ensure alignment and successful execution of operational goals, focusing on operational excellence, cost-saving initiatives, and continuous improvement.

About You
You will bring the following skills and experience:
•	Manufacturing Leadership: Extensive senior operational management experience with a track record of improving plant operations, driving site performance, driving manufacturing excellence and achieving performance targets in a multi-site environment. 
•	COPQ Expertise: Proven track record in reducing COPQ and implementing strategies to improve product quality and profitability across manufacturing sites.
•	Operational Excellence: Deep knowledge of lean manufacturing, process optimization, and cost-saving initiatives to enhance operational performance.

•	Driver’s License: Hold a current unrestricted driver’s license to perform the requirements of the role.
•	Educational Qualification: A diploma or degree in a relevant discipline (business, engineering, manufacturing) or equivalent experience is preferred.

About the Benefits

Where you'll be working
 

St Vincent's Health Network Sydney (SVHN) forms part of the NSW region of St Vincent's Health Australia which is the largest diversified health care organisation within Australia's not for profit and Catholic health care sectors. SVHN comprises some of Australia's oldest and most prestigious hospitals; these include St Vincent's Hospital and Sacred Heart Hospice. Along with three co-located research institutes - the Victor Chang Cardiac Research Institute, the Garvan Institute of Medical Research, and St Vincent's Institute of Medical Research - we work in close partnership with other research bodies, universities, and health care providers.

St Vincent's Hospital is a major public hospital and a principal tertiary referral hospital. St Vincent's specialises in heart-lung transplantation; bone marrow transplantation; cardiology; neurosurgery, cancer; clinical genomics, HIV medicine; palliative care, respiratory medicine; mental health; and drug and alcohol services, aged psychiatry, homeless health and prisoner health. We are a clinical and education leader with a national and international reputation in medical research.

Centrally located in Darlinghurst, it sits on the edge of Sydney's business district. St Vincent's follows the philosophy of the Mary Aikenhead Ministries in its service to all regardless of race, nationality or creed. The Hospital has a long-standing reputation for treating the highest acuity and complex patient loads, attracting referrals on a state-wide and national basis. Employment Type: Permanent, Full-time

About the company:
Our client Scidell Pty Ltd is a newly formed scientific delivery alliancing company of Multicom Resources Pty Ltd. Scidell is dedicated to providing cost-effective solutions to Multicom Resources, its foundation alliance client, while also seeking opportunities to expand its services.

Multicom Resources is a Queensland-based exploration and minerals refining company focused on discovering and developing world-class mineral deposits. Among its key projects is the Saint Elmo Project, located in the Northwest Minerals Province of Queensland. This project is advancing the production of vanadium and high-purity alumina, essential resources for global technology manufacturers.

About the role:
As a Control Room Operator at Scidell, you will play a vital role in the operations of the Saint Elmo Mine's mineral processing plant. Reporting to the Plant Manager, this position involves monitoring and optimizing plant equipment using advanced HMI systems and automated controls. You’ll be instrumental in ensuring plant safety, efficiency, and compliance with production goals and regulatory standards.
This is a full-time role operating on a rotating roster.

Key Requirements:
-A minimum of 1 year of experience in a similar role, such as a Control Room Operator, or within a related field, such as mining or mineral processing.
-A demonstrated ability to quickly learn and apply knowledge about process plant operations.
-Proficiency in operating and troubleshooting HMI and automated control systems (e.g., DCS, SCADA).
-Strong problem-solving skills to assess process disturbances and implement corrective actions effectively.
-Attention to detail to monitor plant conditions and identify operational changes.
-A commitment to maintaining safety and compliance with health, safety, and environmental standards.

Key Responsibilities:
-Monitor and control plant equipment using modern HMI and automated systems to ensure efficient and safe operations.
-Detect and respond to changes in process conditions and troubleshoot equipment issues.
-Collaborate with field operators and maintenance personnel to resolve process disruptions.
-Coordinate plant start-ups, shutdowns, and emergency operations to minimize downtime.
-Review plant performance data to identify trends and implement process optimizations.
-Support continuous improvement initiatives and contribute to enhancing plant efficiency.
-Maintain compliance with safety protocols and assist in training new operators.

Why Join Us?
Scidell offers a unique opportunity to contribute to cutting-edge mineral processing projects while working in a supportive and collaborative environment. Be part of a team that values innovation, safety, and excellence in delivering critical minerals to global markets.

How to Apply:
If you're ready to be part of a dynamic team at Scidell Pty Ltd, dedicated to innovation and excellence, we’d love to hear from you! Please submit your application, ensuring you highlight your relevant experience and qualifications.

Scidell Pty Ltd is an equal-opportunity employer, committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive workplace. We encourage applications from individuals of all backgrounds. While we appreciate every application, please note that only those selected for an interview will be contacted.

Travel Agency Manager

Happy Travels is Australia’s leading backpacker travel agency, built on a passion for adventure and a commitment to creating unforgettable experiences. Despite the challenges faced by the travel industry in recent years, we’ve continued to grow by staying focused on what matters most - our people and our travellers.

We’re more than just a booking service. We’re a tight-knit, energetic team dedicated to helping backpackers and tourists make the most of their time in Australia, Fiji, and New Zealand. From once-in-a-lifetime tours to hidden local gems, we connect travellers with experiences that turn trips into lifelong memories.

At Happy Travels, it’s all about people, connection, and adventure.

Role Overview:

As a Travel Agency Manager, your primary focus will be to oversee the operations of our travel agency, ensuring exceptional service delivery and maximising sales performance. You will lead a team of Travel Sales Consultants, motivating and guiding them to achieve sales targets and provide outstanding customer experiences. A crucial part of your role will be the recruitment, training, and development of staff, ensuring they are equipped with the skills and knowledge to excel in their roles.

Key Responsibilities:
- Leading and overseeing the overall operations and strategic direction of the travel agency.
- Developing and implementing business plans and strategies to achieve company objectives and targets.
- Managing financial aspects, including budgeting, forecasting, and financial performance analysis.
- Building and maintaining relationships with key stakeholders, such as travel suppliers, partners, and clients.
- Analysing market trends and competitor activities to identify opportunities and threats in the industry.
- Recruiting, training, and mentoring staff members to ensure a high level of professionalism and service quality.
- Setting performance goals and KPIs for the team, monitoring progress, and providing guidance as needed.
- Driving sales and revenue growth through effective marketing, pricing strategies, and product offerings.
- Developing and maintaining operational policies, procedures, and standards to ensure efficiency and compliance.
- Handling escalated customer issues and complaints, seeking resolution, and maintaining customer satisfaction.
- Negotiating contracts and agreements with suppliers to secure favourable terms and conditions.
- Staying updated on industry regulations, compliance requirements, and best practices.
- Utilising technology tools and systems to streamline operations and enhance customer experience.
- Analysing data and metrics to evaluate performance, identify areas for improvement, and make informed decisions.
- Representing the company at industry events, conferences, and trade shows to network and promote services.
- Monitoring and managing risk factors, such as safety, security, and legal liabilities, to protect the company’s interests.
- Fostering a positive work culture and environment that encourages teamwork, innovation, and continuous improvement.

Benefits:
- Competitive salary with performance-based incentives and superannuation package.
- Opportunities for career advancement and professional development.
- Travel incentives and familiarisation trips.
- Exclusive discounts on transport and accommodation.
- A supportive and dynamic work environment.

Qualifications:
- 3+ years experience as a travel agency manager or Diploma or Higher plus 1 year of experience.
- Strong leadership skills with the ability to motivate and inspire a team.
- Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
- A passion for travel and a commitment to delivering exceptional customer experiences.
- Experience in staff recruitment, training, and development.
- Multilingual skills are a significant advantage.

Australian Citizens & Permanent Residents are encouraged to apply.

Join the Happy Travels team and lead the way in creating unforgettable experiences for travellers and adventurers. Apply now to become our Travel Agency Manager and embark on a rewarding career journey!
